major_events: Yin-Yang Strength Erasure (第九十八节)：方源 uses Yin Cloud Gu and Yang Cloud Gu to create a lightning field to erase a duplicate wild boar strength, utilizing One-Step Success Gu to speed up the process.
Bitter Strength Auction Scam (第一百零六节 - 第一百零九节)：In the Ju clan asset auction, 方源 tricks 商睚眦 into buying a Bitter Strength Gu for 810,000 stones, causing him a massive financial loss.
Value of Recipe (第一百零九节)：魏央 purchases the unverified 4-turn Heavenly Yuan Treasure Lotus recipe for 670,000 stones.
Reaching 3-Turn Peak (第一百一十三节)：方源 utilizes resources to reach the peak of 3-turn, preparing for his ultimate ascent.
Shang City Arena Triumph (第一百一十八节 - 第一百二十节)：方源 defeats the strength path master 巨开碑, winning the final battle stage and acquiring massive reputation in Shang Clan City.
Opening of the Three Kings Inheritance (第一百二十四节)：The Three Kings Inheritance (Xin Wang, Bao Wang, Xiao Wang) opens on San Cha Mountain, drawing numerous righteous and demonic Gu Masters.
Nine-Eye Liquor Worm Refinement (第一百二十七节)：方源 refines the Nine-Eye Liquor Worm to boost his essence cultivation speed.
Departure from Shang City (第一百三十四节)：方源 and 白凝冰 leave Shang Clan City, heading for San Cha Mountain.
Fang Zheng's Resolve (第一百三十五节)：方正 under the Xianhe Sect prepares to take the Hu Immortal inheritance, harboring deep hatred for 方源.
Slaughtering Opponents at San Cha Mountain (第一百四十一节 - 第一百四十二节)：方源 kills challengers and enemies in San Cha Mountain, gaining a reputation for extreme ruthlessness.
Entering the Dog King Inheritance (第一百四十七节 - 第一百五十二节)：方源 enters the Dog King Inheritance (犬王传承) and demonstrates incredible Slave Path (奴道) attainment, commanding large groups of dogs.
Battle with Seven Opponents (第一百六十一节 - 第一百六十四节)：方源 fights and defeats seven Gu Masters simultaneously at San Cha Mountain, solidifying his reputation.

Opening of the Hu Immortal Blessed Land (第一百六十六节)：The Hu Immortal Blessed Land opens in Central Continent, and the ten great ancient sects launch a competition to climb Dang Hun Mountain and claim the inheritance.
Refined and Betrayed (Cycle 1 - 第一百九十七节 - 第二百节)：In the Southern Border Three Kings Inheritance bronze hall, 方源 attempts to refine the Second Aperture Gu (第二空窍蛊), but is stabbed in the back by 白凝冰.
Rebirth via Spring Autumn Cicada (Cycle 1 - 第二百节)：Forced into a corner, 方源 detonates himself to activate the Spring Autumn Cicada (春秋蝉), traveling back in time to change his fate.
Slavery of Chou Jiu (Cycle 2 - 第二百零二节)：Reborn into the second cycle, 方源 beats and enslaves the famous doctor 仇九 using a 5-turn Slavery Gu (奴隶蛊) by exploiting his psychological weakness.

Refinement of Fixed Immortal Travel (Cycle 2 - 第二百零五节 - 第二百零六节)：方源 pivots from Second Aperture Gu to Fixed Immortal Travel Gu, using Divine Travel, Blue Sky, Fixed Star, and Xiao Mang's Heavenly Waterfall Light River.

Stealing the Hu Immortal Blessed Land (第一节 - 第四节)：方源 teleports to Mount Tian Ti in Central Continent using the newly refined Fixed Immortal Travel Gu, climbs Dang Hun Mountain, beats 凤金煌 and 方正, and claims the Hu Immortal Blessed Land.
Surviving the Earth Calamity (第十一节 - 第十二节)：Under 方源's command and with the stone men's hard work, the blessed land successfully survives its first Earth Calamity.
Entering Northern Plains (第二十一节)：方源 enters the Northern Plains, disguised as the legendary Wolf King 常山阴, using the Human Skin Gu (人皮蛊) and Snow Wash Gu (雪洗蛊) to wash away his trace.
Killing Ge Yao (第三十节)：方源 stabs 葛谣 to death after she successfully kills the thousand-beast wolf king, eliminating her as a potential liability to his disguise, and takes all her Gu worms.
Welcome at the Ge Clan Camp (第三十四节 - 第三十五节)：方源 is welcomed as a hero by the Ge clan, successfully establishing his fake identity as 常山阴.

long_form_mechanisms.system: Spring Autumn Cicada Rebirth (春秋蝉重生机制)
long_form_mechanisms.details: A 6-turn Immortal Gu containing the law of time. A Gu Master self-detonates their entire body, Gu worms, and cultivation as fuel to drive their consciousness/will into the River of Time, traveling back to a point in the past. It is extremely risky; failure results in complete annihilation, and using it as a mortal causes severe soul damage.

long_form_mechanisms.system: Fixed Immortal Travel Refinement Recipe (定仙游炼制秘方)
long_form_mechanisms.details: According to the Legends of Ren Zu, refining Fixed Immortal Travel requires Divine Travel Gu (神游蛊), the Jade Bamboo of Green Heaven (represented by the 5-turn Blue Sky Gu 碧空蛊), the Eight-Cornered Diamond Star Dust of Blue Heaven (represented by the Fixed Star Gu 定星蛊), and the Ancient Glory Light (represented by Xiao Mang's light-path killer move 天瀑光河). Time acceleration (using Third Shift Gu 三更蛊) is used to mature the refinement instantly when the light source is cut.

long_form_mechanisms.system: Slavery Gu Control & Will Collapse (奴隶蛊控制与灵魂防线)
long_form_mechanisms.details: Enslaving a 5-turn Gu Master using a 5-turn Slavery Gu (奴隶蛊) requires the target's soul defenses/will to be broken. If the target's willpower remains strong, they can resist control and cause a backlash. Fang Yuan physically beats Chou Jiu and psychologically breaks him by exposing his secret love for Chen Jiu to successfully bypass his soul defense.

long_form_mechanisms.system: Blessed Land and Land Spirit Inheritance (福地与地灵规则)
long_form_mechanisms.details: A Blessed Land forms when a Gu Immortal dies, and if they die with a strong obsession, that obsession merges with the land's power to form a Land Spirit (地灵). The Land Spirit manages the blessed land and its resources but can only be inherited by a Gu Master who meets the specific conditions of the deceased Immortal's obsession (e.g. climbing Dang Hun Mountain first).

long_form_mechanisms.system: Soul Cultivation via Dang Hun Mountain Guts Stones (荡魂山与胆石魂魄滋养)
long_form_mechanisms.details: Dang Hun Mountain is a soul-shattering danger zone, but it produces Guts Stones (胆石) when souls perish. Gu Masters can crush these stones to directly strengthen and heal their own soul. Fang Yuan uses these stones to recover from the severe soul damage caused by refining Fixed Immortal Travel Gu as a mortal.

long_form_mechanisms.system: Blessed Land Earth Calamities (福地地灾防御)
long_form_mechanisms.details: Blessed lands face periodic disasters sent by Heaven's Will, known as Earth Calamities (地灾) and Heaven Tribulations. The land spirit and the owner must coordinate defense strategies, such as using non-human labor forces (Stone Men) to dig large drainage canals to redirect mud disasters or utilizing specific defense Gu.

long_form_mechanisms.system: Identity Disguise via Human Skin Gu & Snow Wash Gu (人皮蛊与雪洗蛊)
long_form_mechanisms.details: In Northern Plains, investigation Gu can easily identify foreign souls or bodies. A Gu Master uses the Human Skin Gu (人皮蛊) to wear the physical skin of a deceased local, and then uses Snow Wash Gu (雪洗蛊) to wash away their foreign soul traces, allowing them to perfectly blend in and pass inspections.

long_form_mechanisms.system: One-Step Success Gu Time Acceleration (一蹴而就蛊加速规则)
long_form_mechanisms.details: A 4-turn time-path Gu that accelerates the local passage of time. Fang Yuan uses it to speed up the process of erasing duplicate strength path footprints within his body (using Yin/Yang Cloud Gu's lightning array), compressing a 19-day process into an instant.

long_form_mechanisms.system: Yin-Yang Cloud Strength Deletion Array (阴阳二云蛊消磨力量规则)
long_form_mechanisms.details: By deploying the downward-sinking Yin Cloud Gu and upward-rising Yang Cloud Gu, a Gu Master creates a localized lightning field. This lightning targets the physical law fragments of animal strengths (such as boar strength) embedded in the Gu Master's body, dissolving them to optimize the strength path layout.

continuity_observations: Regional Suppression Law (第二十三节): Southern Border Gu worms (like Self-Reliance Gu and Jin Feng Song Shuang Gu) are suppressed by one rank when brought to Northern Plains, reflecting the regional barrier system.

Fixed Immortal Travel Teleportation (第二百零六节): The logical consistency of Fang Yuan teleporting to Mount Tian Ti relies on his retains of future memories, allowing him to visualize a location he has seen in his past life.

Bai Ningbing's Gender State (第一百九十七节): Bai Ningbing's sudden return to his male body implies that Tie Ruonan provided the Yang Gu off-screen in exchange for his betrayal, resolving his gender dilemma.

Spring Autumn Cicada Soul Backlash (第三节): Waking up with severe soul fatigue and headache highlights the physical/soul limits of a mortal using a 6-turn Immortal Gu, necessitating the use of Guts Stones to heal.

Blessed Land Time Dilution (第四节): The time ratio inside Hu Immortal Blessed Land is 5:1 compared to the outside world, creating a consistent pacing difference between internal cultivation and external events.

Legends of Ren Zu Moral Integration (第三十节): Fang Yuan justifies his cold-blooded murder of Ge Yao by quoting the story of the stone man blocking the path of Gu Yue Yin Huang from the Legends of Ren Zu, demonstrating consistent ideological framing.
Shang Yazi's Grudge Continuity (第一百零五节): Shang Yazi obstructing Fang Yuan's trade of Bitter Strength Gu is a logical consequence of Fang Yuan blackmailing him earlier in Shang Clan City.

Central Continent Sect Regulations (第一节 - 第二节): The ten sects compete via selected disciples climbing Mount Tian Ti rather than deployment of high-level Immortals, showing the structured geopolitical rules of Central Continent.
style_observations: Allegorical Parables: Integrating fictional myths from the 'Legends of Ren Zu' as functional guides for Gu recipes and philosophical models for characters' choices.
Brutal Philosophical Monologues: The text is marked by Fang Yuan's cold, pragmatic thoughts on success, love, and life, framing emotions as liabilities.
Meticulous Gu Mechanics: Describing battle and refinement procedures with highly technical detail, listing ranks, elemental properties, and energy costs.
Poetic Chapter Headings: Utilizing traditional Chinese couplets or poetic language for key chapters (e.g., 第二百零六节: 今日暂且展翼去，明朝登仙笞凤凰！).
Cyclical Narrative (Rebirth Sequence): Implementing a time-loop structure where the protagonist restarts a sequence with future knowledge, creating dramatic irony.
Campfire Contrast: Juxtaposing the warm, romantic campfire environment and Ge Yao's deep love with Fang Yuan's frozen, murderous inner thoughts.

creation_family_evidence.publisher_notes: Includes the standard Qidian author note '(未完待续。如果您喜欢这部作品，欢迎您来起点投推荐票、月票，您的支持，就是我最大的动力。)' at the end of chapters, indicating it was serialized on the Qidian platform.
creation_family_evidence.aggregator_watermarks: Contains signature patterns from web scrapers, such as '/manghuangji为您提供精彩小说阅读。' (referencing the novel Manghuangji), '文学馆' (Wenxueguan), '文學馆', and '¤文学吧：wxba¤' (Wenxueba) embedded within the text.
creation_family_evidence.textual_crossovers: Includes accidental title injections from other scraped novels, such as '大内高手最新章节', '重生左唯全文阅读', and '农女的秀色田园全文阅读', which are typical remnants of automated web aggregation scripts.

originality_risks: Mythological Anthologizing (Legends of Ren Zu): Mirrors classical Chinese mythological anthologies like the 'Classic of Mountains and Seas', presenting a risk of mimicking traditional Chinese fable styles.
Rebirth and Future Knowledge Trope: The use of time travel (rebirth) to undo defeats and bypass obstacles with future information is a widely used trope in the web novel regression subgenre.
The Edgy Anti-Hero Archetype: Fang Yuan's extreme pragmatism, lack of empathy, and cold-blooded murder of Ge Yao borders on the edgy anti-hero convention popular in dark fantasy web fiction.
Fantasy Races Adapting Western Tropes: Non-human helper/crafter races like the Hairy Men and Stone Men adapt typical Golem/Dwarf tropes into a cultivation context.
